description: This file defines REST API routes for managing LLM cost records, including endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting records. It uses Express.js for routing, imports controllers, models, and utility functions, and includes Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: router.get '/'
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list LLM cost records, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: router.post '/'
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new LLM cost record.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an LLM cost record by ID.
